# Pricewatcha API documentation

Canonical guides for the REST API. The [Developer page](https://pricewatcha.com/en/developers) and [README.md](../README.md) are built from this directory.

See [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md) for the edit → `build_readme.py` → `sync_api_docs.sh` workflow.

**Do not edit `README.md` by hand** — run `python scripts/build_readme.py` from the repository root.
